description: This file contains a PHP class `PaymentMethod` in the `Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account` namespace. It defines an MVC controller for managing payment methods in the customer's account section of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class includes methods for listing available payment methods, editing, deleting, and rendering views related to payment options, along with associated helper functions.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class managing customer's payment methods, providing listing, editing, and deletion functionalities within the account section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main payment method page, initializing language, session, and view data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of payment methods available to the logged-in customer, handling redirection if not logged in.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the list of available payment methods by querying extensions and their stored data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a specified payment method, updating session and returning JSON response.
